content.p: This Act is the Transport Security Amendment (Testing and Training) Act 2020.

section.heading: Exemption from requirements relating to screening officers

content.p: The Secretary may, in writing, exempt a class of screening officers from one or more requirements determined under paragraph 94A(a) if the Secretary is satisfied that exceptional circumstances exist.
An exemption under subsection (1) may be subject to specified conditions.

section.heading: Exercise of powers and performance of screening functions by screening officers

content.p: A screening officer may only exercise a power under this Division or perform a screening function if the screening officer has met each requirement determined under paragraph 94A(a):
that relates to the screening officer’s exercise or performance of the power or function; and
for which the screening officer is not exempt under subsection 94B(1).
In exercising a power under this Division or performing a screening function, a screening officer must not use more force, or subject a person to greater indignity, than is necessary and reasonable.

The annual report prepared by the Secretary and given to the Minister under section 46 of the Public Governance, Performance and Accountability Act 2013 for a period must include the number of exemptions given by the Secretary under subsection 94B(1) in that period.
Repeal the section.
